concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = "org.slf4j.Logger" SET t:Logger:Slf4j RETURN t.fqn
MATCH (t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = "org.apache.commons.logging.Log" SET t:Logger:Commons RETURN t.fqn

constraint.description: Only the usage of Slf4 is allowed
constraint.cypher: MATCH (logger:Type:Logger)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method), (t:Type:Shopizer)-[:DECLARES]->(:Method)-[usage:INVOKES]->(m) WHERE NOT logger:Slf4j RETURN t.fqn AS Type, logger.fqn AS Logger, collect(usage.lineNumber) AS LineNumbers

constraint.description: Don't use System.out and System.err in production code for logging
constraint.cypher: MATCH (system:Type{fqn: "java.lang.System"})-[:DECLARES]->(writer:Field), (a:Shopizer:Main:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method), (m)-[reads:READS]->(writer) WHERE writer.signature in [ "java.io.PrintStream out", "java.io.PrintStream err" ] RETURN t.fqn as Type, writer.signature, collect(reads.lineNumber) as LineNumbers
